Alex C: Heads up — dedicated canary (reserved pool eu-west-1) started showing a p95 surge after merge 5f3a8b. Kernel selection is oscillating and the KV cache is getting evicted repeatedly; fallback loop to slower kernel seems to be amplifying tails. This is hitting reserved customers' SLA. Attaching quick snippets.

Mica H: link? which canary cluster?

Alex C: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/abc/perf?orgId=1&panelId=9
Logs (tail):
```
[2026-03-18T02:45:12Z] [evict] kv-cache: miss key=abc123
[2026-03-18T02:45:12Z] [kernel] selected=auto_v2 cost=120ms
[2026-03-18T02:45:12Z] [kernel] fallback=legacy cost=320ms
[2026-03-18T02:45:13Z] [route] cache_prefetch=false
[2026-03-18T02:45:13Z] [kernel] selected=auto_v2 cost=150ms
[2026-03-18T02:45:13Z] [kernel] fallback=legacy cost=310ms
```
Looks like selection heuristics pick auto_v2 but initial KV miss forces legacy fallback, then cache eviction repeats.

Samir: CI perf-run-125 also failed on master around the same commit (5f3a8b). Suggest bisect range 5f3a8b..d2c9f4 and/or pin runtime.kernel_hint until we understand. Perf regression ~+18% p95.

Julie P: I recommend we pause the canary and hold rollout. Either revert 5f3a8b or hotpatch to force kernel_hint="legacy" for dedicated pools. Customer-impacting so escalate to oncall.

Tomas L: I can repro locally with longseq workload and KV thrash. Quick repro command:
```
./run_perf.py --model llama-13b --seq 2048 --concurrency 40 --kernel auto_v2 --kv-workload=thrash
```
Also confirmed repeated "cache miss -> fallback" loop.

oncall-bot: Incident created: sla-risk-dedicated-2145678910 (priority: high) — paging oncall.

Alex C: Opened rollback PR: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/4129 — contains revert of kernel-selection heuristics. Will hold for bisect results; if bisect points at 5f3a8b I'll merge revert and roll back canary. Also preparing a hotpatch that forces runtime.kernel_hint: "legacy" for reserved pools.

Mica H: Can we pin the two affected customers to v2026-03-01-rc until this is resolved? That buys time.

Alex C: Done — pinned reserved pools for cust-A and cust-B and paused further canary traffic. Bisect started (running perf matrix). ETA ~90m. Will update here. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
